titulo: A Woman in White Stood in the Middle of the Road | Urban Legend #Shorts
titulo_pt: Uma mulher de branco parada no meio da estrada | Lenda urbana
resumo_pt: Lenda da Dama de Branco. Numa noite de tempestade, o narrador quase atropela uma mulher de vestido branco parada no meio da estrada. Ele freia, ela some. Ele desce pra procurar e vê que, logo depois da curva, a ponte tinha sido levada pela enchente. No dia seguinte, um velho da cidade conta que uma noiva morreu naquela ponte em outra enchente, e desde então ela aparece pra parar os carros.
descricao:
He thought he was going to hit her.

Would you have stopped?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Based on a classic American urban legend. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: I was driving home through the worst storm I'd ever seen.
scenes.pt: Eu estava voltando pra casa na pior tempestade que eu já tinha visto.
scenes.visual: car headlights on a dark country road in heavy rain

scenes.text: Old country road. No lights. Just my headlights and the rain.
scenes.pt: Estrada de terra velha. Sem luz nenhuma. Só meus faróis e a chuva.
scenes.visual: rain hitting a windshield, wipers moving, dark road ahead

scenes.text: I came around a curve, and there she was.
scenes.pt: Eu fiz uma curva e lá estava ela.
scenes.visual: road curve in the rain lit by headlights

scenes.text: A woman in a long white dress. Standing in the middle of the road.
scenes.pt: Uma mulher de vestido branco comprido. Parada no meio da estrada.
scenes.visual: woman in a long white dress standing in the middle of a rainy road, lit by headlights

scenes.text: She wasn't wet. The rain was pouring, and she wasn't wet.
scenes.pt: Ela não estava molhada. Chovia muito, e ela não estava molhada.

scenes.text: I slammed the brakes. The car slid and stopped inches from her.
scenes.pt: Pisei no freio. O carro derrapou e parou a centímetros dela.
scenes.visual: car skidding on a wet road at night, headlights blurred

scenes.text: I blinked. And she was gone.
scenes.visual: empty rainy road lit by headlights, nobody there

scenes.text: I got out with my flashlight. I was sure I'd hit her.
scenes.pt: Desci com a lanterna. Eu tinha certeza que tinha atropelado ela.
scenes.visual: man with a flashlight searching in front of a car in the rain at night

scenes.text: No one. But I heard water. A lot of water.
scenes.pt: Ninguém. Mas eu ouvi água. Muita água.
scenes.visual: flashlight beam on a muddy road in the rain

scenes.text: Twenty feet ahead, the bridge was gone. The flood had swept it away.
scenes.pt: Seis metros à frente, a ponte tinha sumido. A enchente tinha levado ela.
scenes.visual: broken bridge over a raging flooded river at night, flashlight beam

scenes.text: If I hadn't stopped, I would've driven straight into the river.
scenes.pt: Se eu não tivesse parado, teria caído direto no rio.
scenes.visual: dark raging river below a broken road edge at night

scenes.text: The next day, I told the story at the gas station in town.
scenes.pt: No dia seguinte, contei a história no posto da cidade.
scenes.visual: small town gas station on a gray morning

scenes.text: An old man just nodded. Like he'd heard it before.
scenes.pt: Um senhor só balançou a cabeça. Como se já tivesse ouvido aquilo antes.
scenes.visual: old man in a cap nodding slowly inside a small gas station

scenes.text: Fifty years ago, a bride drowned at that bridge. In a flood just like this one.
scenes.pt: Cinquenta anos atrás, uma noiva se afogou naquela ponte. Numa enchente igual a essa.

scenes.text: She was on her way to her wedding. Since then, every flood, she stops the cars.
scenes.pt: Ela estava indo pro casamento. Desde então, toda enchente, ela para os carros.
scenes.visual: old black and white photo of a bride in a white dress

scenes.text: She couldn't save herself. So she saves everyone else.
scenes.pt: Ela não conseguiu se salvar. Então ela salva todo mundo.
scenes.visual: woman in white standing far away on a misty riverbank at dawn

personagens: the narrator is a bearded man in his forties with a denim jacket and a cap; the ghost is a pale woman with long black hair in a white wedding dress; the old man at the gas station has a gray mustache and overalls
